fields.subject: the ArgentSea.Pg project's NuGet packaging configuration
fields.where: IncludeSymbols is set to true and SymbolPackageFormat is set to snupkg in ArgentSea.Pg.csproj
fields.trigger: when GeneratePackageOnBuild (also set to true) causes the project to be packed automatically on build
fields.response: the packaging configuration specifies that a companion symbol package in .snupkg format be designated separately from the main package, rather than embedding debugging symbols within it
fields.postcondition: so that ArgentSea.Pg's symbol-package format and its separation from the main package are explicit configuration choices rather than left to NuGet packaging defaults
